//: Thresholds, not aspirations. These are set at what the site currently clears so a
regression is visible; raising them is a deliberate act, and lowering one to make a
build pass should be a commit somebody has to justify.
Performance is a warning rather than an error because a cold CloudFront edge in the
runner's region can cost twenty points on a first request, and failing a deploy over
that would teach everyone to ignore the check.
